technicalGate.validatedExportRoute: Origin/OriginPro on Windows using originpro/PyOrigin or equivalent validated OriginLab export
technicalGate.thirdPartyConverterReference: JNisk/convert-opju, MIT, requires Origin 2024b on Windows

exportAcceptance: Each exported worksheet/matrix must retain originating OPJU file, project folder, book/sheet name, units/comments/formulas when available.
Exported tables must be fingerprinted and reconciled against the five already-verified OPJU source hashes.
Time columns, directly measured channels and derived/visualisation-only tables must be separated before sample counting.
No graph-rendering or representative-curve workbook may be counted as an independent experiment if it duplicates raw acquisition data.
evidenceBoundary: All five CC BY 4.0 OPJU files are already retrieved and source-hash verified. The remaining blocker is format extraction, not rights. A validated Windows Origin/OriginPro export is required before any trial, channel or sample count can be accepted.
